title: The five-year management contract Buck signed alone
summary: Nazarro got Buck to sign a five-year contract without Bubbles, who could not go on without his partner.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: What kind of an agreement did you have with Nazarro that he had the ability --
He was a manager, man, he was a manager.
But what agreement did you have with him? Was it a lifetime --

Almost the same thing -- five years, five-year agreement. It was five years and I had to take on top of what Buck did. See, I wasn't going to sign no more with him from the time I told you concerning the case. I was just going to just stall around and not play no more. But he got Buck to sign a contract without me, that he would have Buck on the contract. He might not have me, but where do I go without Buck. I would have nowhere to go without Buck, like Buck would have no place to go without me. We were a team, you know. So that's how you sandwish that up.
Sort of double-crossed you in a certain way.
Yeah. I can't get Buck to understand what he's doing, 'cause he's just like Chuck, he's just like Chuck.
